name: Document Bootstrap Requested
description:
Event requesting creation or initialization of a Blue document or document-processing session. Bootstrap requests are
used when a participant, service, or parent document wants another component to instantiate a document, bind initial
channels, seed initial messages, or assign responsibility for the new document.

The request may carry the document to bootstrap, channel binding information, initial messages, an assignee, and an
actor on whose behalf the bootstrap is requested. The bootstrap processor should validate the document under Blue
Language and Blue Contracts rules before returning a completion response.

document.description: Document content, template, reference, or descriptor to bootstrap. The concrete bootstrap runtime defines the accepted shape.

channelBindings.description: Mapping from channel names to binding descriptors used to connect the new document to timelines or other event sources.

initialMessages.description: Optional initial messages to place on channels or timelines during bootstrap. Shape is runtime-specific.

defaultMessage.description: Default invitation message sent to all participants.

bootstrapAssignee.description: Actor, account, or service responsible for completing the bootstrap.

onBehalfOf.description: Actor or principal for whom the bootstrap is being requested.
